pending_vector_growth.capacity_rule: The full-path element count is (end-begin)>>2. Count zero selects one element; a nonzero count is doubled.
copy_order: store noun in the new insertion slot
deallocate old begin only when begin is nonzero and the preceding allocation marker is nonzero
in_place_shift_order: when position equals end and spare capacity exists, store the inserted noun and AddRef it without reading or releasing an old value
otherwise, with position before end and a populated predecessor, duplicate the old last element into the new end slot and AddRef it
walk backward from the old last element toward the insertion position
for each unequal source and destination, AddRef the source, store it, then Release the old destination
AddRef the inserted noun, store it, then Release the replaced noun
advance end by four without changing begin or capacity
pending_vector_growth.growth_order: The stored-slot AddRef occurs after the noun pointer store and before the suffix copy and old-buffer deallocation.
pending_vector_growth.empty_buffer_behavior: A null begin with null end and null capacity allocates one slot, stores noun, retains the stored noun, and does not deallocate an old buffer.
pending_vector_growth.zero_marker_behavior: A nonzero old begin whose preceding marker is zero is not passed to the deallocation port.

failure_boundaries.null_manager: No guard precedes manager+0x84 access after the initial noun vtable call.
failure_boundaries.null_noun: The first write to noun+0x20 faults before any vtable access.
failure_boundaries.invalid_vtable: The first slot-zero call faults without rollback of noun+0x20.
failure_boundaries.allocation_failure: No null-allocation guard precedes the new-buffer store; the function has no recovery path.
failure_boundaries.in_place_zero_end: A null begin, null end, nonzero capacity advances the raw end word to four but skips the slot store and stored-slot AddRef because the old end word was zero.
